title: Megha Mandara
desc: A pregnant woman goes into shock after hearing the news of her husband's accidental death. The man miraculously survives and returns to his wife who remains catatonic after losing her child.

title: Mayura
desc: Mayura, a Brahmin boy, discovers his connections to the royal family. He then takes it upon himself to avenge the death of his father and works towards building his kingdom.

title: MMCH
desc: Hardened policewoman Jhansirani is tasked with identifying a dead woman who was found in a landfill. Her path crosses with that of three roommates trying to save their friend from a bad boyfriend.

title: Naanu Matthu Gunda 2
desc: A warm story unfolds between a lonely man and a loyal dog whose bond transforms their lives, bringing companionship, healing and emotional strength through life's struggles.

title: Milana
desc: Anjali's father forces her to marry Akash. Unable to forget her past, she demands a divorce from Akash, but soon begins to fall for him.

title: Arjun
desc: Arjun steps in to protect his twin sister when her in-laws attempt to kill her.
